blocks.text: The prosecution for the violation of municipal ordinances shall be commenced by the filing of a complaint with the Municipal Court. (Ord. 20206 § 9, 9-10-19; Ord. 17666 § 17, 3-27-01. Code 1995 § 50-52. Formerly 2.110.150.)
State Law References: Similar State statute, K.S.A. 12-4201 .
